title: Ripped but good customer service
text:
Ripped but good customer service. Extremely thin and not that warm. More of a light blanket than a comforter.
Update : Bought this in the end of December 2020 and it’s now the end of October 2021 and the threading is coming apart at the seams. It was used in a spare bedroom that’s been used less than 10 times so it’s been washed less than 10 times and the seams are coming apart. I reached out to the company and they fixed the issue but because of the issue with the product I still won’t give 5 stars.
